name: TrumpNet
summary: Tasmania's first commercial ISP; the ISP division of Trumpet Software International (Trumpet Winsock, Peter Tattam); statewide dialup + web hosting; receivership mid-2007, customers to Internet Tasmania (Intas) 1 Aug 2007; domain later on iiNet infrastructure.

events.details: Started providing Internet access as Trumpet Software International in 1994.
Receivership mid-2007; customers to Intas 1 Aug 2007.
